text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, Dantsu-san!
Perform this opera together with me!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeeeek~~!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, no way, Opera O-chan!
I've never done any acting before...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That is precisely why!
Let me hear your youthful concertato!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"'Oh, my beloved subjects!
This Overlord shall surely crush the enemy forces for you!'"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, making her entrance is the Queen! Anxious for the King's safety,
she makes the resolute choice to plunge into the battlefield herself!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm the queen!? Um... err...
"Oh King~! If we go on like this, it'll be dangerous~!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! What an utterly adorable queen!
However...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The castle is already surrounded by a vast army! The queen is truly prepared to lay down her life!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then... how about, "Let's defeat
the enemy soldiers together!" ...or something?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's it! At this rate, the King will lose his life!
Make that tension burn passionately, make it boil over!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! "I shall never let anyone
take the King's life!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"‘...With the two of us together, an army
of hundreds or thousands is no match for us!’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Let us fight together. We shall
make our power known to this world!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Huh, somehow...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I think... I've got it down!
Push further ahead, with courage...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, that's it...
These feelings will surely carry over into my running, too—!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!
choice_data_list: Your finishing kick... it's gotten even sharper!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That felt pretty good just now, didn't it!
choice_data_list: You're keeping a good focus on pushing forward.
You're keeping a good focus on pushing forward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think I might've gotten the hang of it a little!
I'm going in for one more lap!
